title: Add discovery module and verbs: scan maps, compute frontier, create stub
action: Create a discovery module in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/ owning: (a) scan of docs/discovery/*/MAP.md returning per-effort {name, destination line, open/frontier ticket counts} where a ticket file under tickets/ is frontier when status open, no claimed-by, and every blocked-by target is closed (per D7 conventions; ticket frontmatter keys: type, status, claimed-by, blocked-by); (b) verb `bee discovery list` (json flag like siblings) printing the scan; (c) verb `bee discovery stub --effort <slug> --from <text>` creating docs/discovery/<slug>/MAP.md with Destination '(unknown — charting session needed)', the --from text under Notes, empty remaining sections per D2 — typed refusal if the effort dir already exists, nothing written on refusal. Wire the verb group into router.rs following an existing small verb group's registration. Unit/integration tests per the plan's test matrix rows for scan, frontier calc, stub create, stub refuse, malformed map. Run cargo test for the touched suites; commit.
